key: [B]The rhythm system is fundamentally polymetric.  There are always multiple rhythm lines, and the beats are always played together, even if one rhythm line completes (and then repeats) before the other is finished. key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  Again on behalf of the Merchants' Guild, let me bid farewell to you and your stout dwarves.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：再次代表商会，向您和您健壮的矮人子民道别。

key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  Although we do not always see eye to eye (ha!), I bid you farewell.  May you someday embrace nature as you embrace the rocks and mud.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：虽然我们的看法不总是一致（哈！），还是向您道别了。愿有朝一日你们能像拥抱岩石和泥土那样拥抱自然。

key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  Farewell, [VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:NOBLE].  I look forward to our meeting next year.  Our fortunes rise and fall together.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：再见了，[VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:NOBLE]。期待我们明年的会面。我们荣辱与共。

key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  Greetings from the woodlands.  We have much to discuss.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：来自林地的问候。我们有许多事要商谈。

key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  Greetings, noble dwarf.  There is much to discuss.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：你好，尊贵的矮人。我们有许多事要商谈。

key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  I am your liaison from the Mountainhomes.  Let's discuss your situation.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：我是来自山之家园的联络官。让我们来谈谈你们的情况。

key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  It has been an honor, noble [VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:NOBLE].  I bid you farewell.
[C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  On behalf of the Merchants' Guild, let me extend greetings to your people.  There is much to discuss.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：我代表商会，向你们的民众致以问候。我们有许多事要商谈。

key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  What a pleasant surprise!  Not a single tree here weeps from the abuses meted out with such ease by your people.  Joy!  The dwarves have turned a page, not that we would make paper.  A travesty!  Perhaps it is better said that the dwarves have turned over a new leaf, and the springtime for our two races has only just begun.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：真是令人惊喜！这里没有一棵树在哭泣，不必再轻易忍受你们族人的摧残。太棒了！矮人翻开了新的一页——不是说我们要造纸。那简直是暴殄天物！或许应该说，矮人改邪归正了，我们两族的春天才刚刚开始。

key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]:  You have disrespected the trees in this area, but this is what we have come to expect from your stunted kind.  Further abuse cannot be tolerated.  Let this be a warning to you.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：你们亵渎了这片土地上的树木，不过这本就是我们预料之中你们这种矮小种族的行径。进一步的侵害绝不能容忍。就当这是对你们的警告。

key: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]: I don't know very much about the outside world.  I wish I had more to tell you.
zh: [C:VAR:MEETING:ACTOR][VAR:NATIVENAME:MEETING:ACTOR]：我对外面的世界了解不多。真希望能告诉你更多的事。
